notes.title: MEATGUN Major Update: Research & Development
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

MEATGUN launched a couple months ago, and I want to thank everyone who has played and enjoyed the game! I've been hard at work on new content for the game, and I'm happy to finally be able to share it with you! 

This update not only comes with an entire new floor to explore, alongside new enemies and hazards, but also new items, troopers, and guns to allow for more variety between runs!

Changes/Bug Fixes:

 Increased Shotgun range
 Fixed issue where Game Over music continued to play after reviving
 Changed Hot Sauce so that proccing the item on an already-burning enemy only increases damage and does not reset the timer
 Changed Pan-Galactic Gargle Blaster so that it activates whenever you heal, but now does a flat 10 damage and has a lower duration 


New Content:

 New Floor: Sublevel B4 - Research & Development

 Brand New Room Designs
 3 New Enemies: Mushrooms, Asparagus, and Avocados
 Hazards: Giant Flytraps, Celery Walls, and more!
 New Music!
 And A New Boss...

 New Items

 Lucky Cereal (Damage)
 Sour Gummies (Damage)
 Aloe Vera (Healing)
 Hand Sanitizer (Healing)
 Double Cherry (Utility)
 Shotgun Coffee (Utility)

 New Troopers

 M.E. Crusader
 M.E. Metalsmith

 New Guns

 Fish (Sword)
 Bacon (Assault Rifle)

 New Achievements

 Doppelganger
 Rally The Troops
 Right To Bear Arms
 Genocide
 Hoplophobia



As for what's coming next, the next update will take MEATGUN out of Early Access, adding the final floor, among other things, to the game. While you wait for that, I hope you enjoy all the content that comes with the Research & Development Update!
